run_pipeline_stable_diffusion_boxdiff: run StableDiffusionBoxDiffPipeline to generate images with spatially controlled object placement via boxdiff_phrases and boxdiff_boxes
create_attention_store: create an AttentionStore to collect and aggregate cross-attention maps across UNet layers during diffusion
test_compute_loss: test the _compute_loss method that combines foreground, background, and corner constraints for BoxDiff optimization
